notes: This adapter uses the LongLive 2.0 BF16 weights. Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 1280x704 at 24 fps, 8-latent (32-frame) causal blocks generated live with the upstream inference.yaml settings (4 UniPC steps, local attention 32 latents, sink 8, multi-shot sink). The block prompt is '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' through upstream's per-block prompt input (no scene-cut prefix, no KV-recache); camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input.
